title: GurtCraft
description: Was Intended to be a vanilla+ pack but i dont think it is at this point. it just revises MC's progression and scenery without taking away from how the game feels.
body:
This modpack is intended for a server of a few friends. it revises the generation in every dimension. using Voxy to offer incredible views with low cost to performance. alters progression to make the game feel a little larger, and gives a use to those copper tools they added. adds new vanilla friendly mobs, structures, food, and other general items. adds a 3 new unique sets of armor and tools as well as 3 more versions of netherite armor and tools. contains small changes to the combat, primarly making an attack right after blocking a crit and enchantment changes. for example, sweeping now increases how many mobs you can hit with one swing, and knockback is now only for axes. it also adds various quality of life mods and performance optimization mods.

this pack is for anyone wanting a vanilla+ experience where most things are enhanced but still the same at its core.
